implementationBaseline.instruction: Start from the current branch head, not a detached historical commit.

statusRules.not_started: No implementation work for this item has begun.
statusRules.in_progress: Implementation or verification is actively underway.
statusRules.blocked: Work cannot proceed until the listed blocker is resolved.
statusRules.complete: All features and completion criteria pass, including the focused tests, typecheck, and full hermetic suite.

tasks.title: Make model responses trustworthy

features.description: Require terminal message_delta, non-error stop reason, message_stop, and closed supported content blocks.
Buffer attempts before history or execution; retry one max_tokens response without committing the rejected attempt.
Use one cancellable ModelDriver for production and TUI request/stream handling.
Enforce finite call/output limits, maxToolCallsPerTurn, and the combined tool-result byte cap before side effects or the next request.

completionCriteria: Truncation, refusal, context exhaustion, max_tokens, and over-cap responses cannot complete a run or execute tools.
Rejected attempts are absent from subsequent model history.
TUI and runTask use the same model driver and cancellation path.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/model/streamAssembly.test.ts src/model/modelDriver.test.ts src/model/callModel.test.ts src/model/callWithRetry.test.ts src/loop/agentLoop.test.ts tests/tui/run-session.test.ts

tasks.title: Preserve one worker session and report truthful outcomes

features.description: Keep one WorkerSession and append verifier corrections without restarting the conversation.
Enforce one finite whole-run budget across initializer, worker, verifier, tools, time, and corrections.
Return verified, incomplete, failed, or cancelled outcomes without mapping judge failure or exhausted corrections to success.
Include every model role in run metrics while preserving current aggregate readers.

completionCriteria: Corrections retain the existing worker messages and browser knowledge.
Budgets never reset between correction cycles.
Judge crash, correction exhaustion, and budget exhaustion are incomplete outcomes.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/loop/workerSession.test.ts src/run/runBudget.test.ts src/harness/harness.test.ts src/cli/runTask.test.ts tests/tui/eval-session.test.ts tests/tui/run-session.test.ts

tasks.title: Replace prose judge verdicts with a typed verifier result

features.description: Return verified or needs_correction through the schema-validated report_verification tool.
Give the verifier only scoped read/image tools and evidence-relevant run data.
Allow one bounded schema repair and fail closed as verifier_unavailable afterward.
Remove DONE and CONTINUE text parsing while preserving screenshot-aware review.

completionCriteria: Ordinary verdict prose has no control-flow meaning.
Malformed, refused, truncated, or missing reports cannot verify a run.
The verifier checks task, contract, output, completeness, and evidence relationships.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/harness/verifier.test.ts src/harness/harness.test.ts src/cli/runTask.test.ts

tasks.title: Introduce one typed output contract

features.description: Implement and cross-validate the OutputContract and OutputSpec schemas.
Persist numbered contract revisions and their evidence, assumption, or user basis through writeArtifact.
Require set_output_contract first and block all later calls when the first contract is missing or invalid.
Support worker and initializer ContractAuthor policies with the same schema and verifier path.

completionCriteria: Both authoring modes produce the same stored representation for the same input.
Missing or invalid first contracts cause zero browser side effects and one result per attempted call.
Tool order and the static prompt prefix remain deterministic.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/contracts/outputContract.test.ts src/contracts/outputContractStore.test.ts src/tools/setOutputContract/setOutputContract.test.ts src/harness/initializer.test.ts src/harness/verifier.test.ts src/tools/index.test.ts src/model/callModel.test.ts

tasks.title: Add explicit submission and code-based completion checks

features.description: Make submit_for_verification an exclusive control tool and remove implicit no-tool completion.
Run objective manifest, file, schema, column, count, uniqueness, capture, marker, and placeholder checks before the verifier.
Return code and verifier findings to the same worker with separate failure counters.
Finalize incomplete runs truthfully and mark only unresolved usable artifacts partial.

completionCriteria: Only submission followed by passing code checks and verification returns verified.
Mixed submission responses execute nothing.
A fake-model integration test completes the full protocol without a real API call.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/completion/completionCheck.test.ts src/completion/workerResponseProtocol.test.ts src/cli/runTask.verification.test.ts src/harness/verifier.test.ts src/harness/harness.test.ts src/run/artifacts.test.ts

tasks.title: Add bounded page-scoped JavaScript

features.description: Execute bounded JSON-returning JavaScript in the selected top document with page locking and result offload.
Persist JavaScript extraction evidence with code, result, URL, and document identity.
Terminate frozen execution and replace an unrecoverable page instead of hanging the run.
Require an explicit allow or deny JavaScript policy for authenticated sessions.

completionCriteria: A fixture list is bulk-extracted in one call with reviewable evidence.
Invalid, oversized, or frozen execution returns bounded failure while the run remains usable.
Authenticated execution cannot occur without an explicit policy.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/tools/executeJavascript/executeJavascript.test.ts src/browser/playwrightBrowserController.test.ts src/tools/capResult.test.ts src/run/artifacts.test.ts src/cli/runTask.test.ts

tasks.title: Store evidence-linked rows and render tables with code

features.description: Add atomic, versioned output-row upsert/delete and table-completeness operations tied to the contract.
Validate exact fields, values, types, uniqueness, formula-leading strings, and evidence IDs before mutation.
Render exact CSV, JSON, or Markdown columns through deterministic application code.
Require completeness evidence for count-ruled tables and render usable partial tables on incomplete runs.
Return derived OutputSummary state so the worker sees table and evidence failures before submission.

completionCriteria: Rendered outputs contain exactly the contract columns in order.
Invalid batches and version conflicts make no partial mutation.
Count-ruled tables require evidence-backed completeness and incomplete runs preserve parseable partial rows.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/outputs/outputTable.test.ts src/outputs/renderTable.test.ts src/outputs/outputSummary.test.ts src/tools/upsertOutputRows/upsertOutputRows.test.ts src/tools/deleteOutputRows/deleteOutputRows.test.ts src/tools/setTableCompleteness/setTableCompleteness.test.ts src/completion/completionCheck.test.ts src/run/artifacts.test.ts evals/grading/manifestVerification.test.ts

tasks.title: Render evidence-linked documents

features.description: Parse evidence markers and enforce document-wide or per-section evidence requirements.
Save the evidence-marked source in scratch and render clean or footnoted requested outputs.
Render PDF from a fixed local template in a dedicated network-disabled page.
Give the verifier the marked source and published render without exposing unrelated scratch data.

completionCriteria: Unknown or insufficient evidence markers fail before verification.
Marked and published artifacts have correct hashes and workspace roles.
Hidden output exposes no raw IDs and footnote output has readable stable references.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/outputs/documentSource.test.ts src/outputs/renderDocument.test.ts src/tools/writeDocument/writeDocument.test.ts src/completion/completionCheck.test.ts src/harness/verifier.test.ts src/run/artifacts.test.ts

tasks.title: Give the browser stable page and observation identity

features.description: Track stable page/frame IDs, document replacement, observation snapshots, popups, and frame changes.
Bind ElementRef to page, frame, and document and re-resolve targets conservatively without ordinal retargeting.
Use basedOnObservationId as a diff baseline and return a full bounded snapshot after cache eviction.
Add observe while keeping legacy atomic browser tools working through adapters.

completionCriteria: Document replacement invalidates old refs but unrelated mutation does not.
Duplicate reordered rows cannot redirect a mutating action.
Popup, frame, and observation identity remain correct across snapshots.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/browser/playwrightBrowserController.test.ts src/tools/observe/observe.test.ts src/tools/inspectPage/inspectPage.test.ts src/tools/click/click.test.ts src/tools/type/type.test.ts

tasks.title: Replace blind browser batches with receipted actions

features.description: Run one to eight same-document actions with per-action receipts and explicit committed effects.
Stop safely on navigation, replacement, popup, dialog, stale target, or failure and report the first unexecuted action.
Implement separate success-check, DOM-quiescence, and settle timeouts plus blocker classification.
Add switch_page and handle_dialog and upgrade JavaScript to explicit page/frame/document targeting.
Reach browser_batch behavioral and diagnostic parity before considering removal.

completionCriteria: Tests distinguish untouched, partial, complete, failed-check, stale, unsettled, and blocked outcomes.
Mid-sequence navigation never executes against the replacement document.
Final-action navigation is reported as completed and uploads cannot escape the run directory.

tasks.title: Add targeted observation and anonymous public-resource reads

features.description: Index deliberately visited or observed URLs and allow only those public resource targets.
Read JSON, CSV, or HTML through an anonymous context and persist original response evidence.
Reject credentials, private/loopback/reserved addresses, and unsafe redirects.
Add targeted text, table, and visual observations plus exact capture_text evidence.
Require visible-UI spot reconciliation before endpoint data becomes final output data.

completionCriteria: Observed public resources return bounded parsed previews and saved original bytes without profile credentials.
Unobserved and private-address targets are rejected.
Targeted table/visual/text observations retain identity and are smaller than full-page output.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/browser/publicResourceReader.test.ts src/browser/discoveredUrlIndex.test.ts src/tools/readResource/readResource.test.ts src/tools/captureText/captureText.test.ts src/tools/observe/observe.test.ts src/evidence/evidenceStore.test.ts

tasks.title: Add PDF, spreadsheet, and OCR content adapters

features.description: Detect trusted content type from bytes and media type and route through a ContentReader registry.
Extract bounded PDF page ranges with text/layout locators and optional page images.
Read bounded spreadsheet sheet/cell ranges with exact addresses and values.
Run cancellable OCR with engine/version/confidence metadata and retained source images.

completionCriteria: PDF, spreadsheet, and OCR fixture output retains page, cell, or image provenance.
Large sources return bounded chunks with continuation ranges.
Cancellation releases parsing work and preserves normal run finalization.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/content/contentReader.test.ts src/content/pdfContentReader.test.ts src/content/spreadsheetContentReader.test.ts src/content/ocrContentReader.test.ts src/tools/inspectDocument/inspectDocument.test.ts src/tools/readResource/readResource.test.ts

tasks.title: Make tool scheduling input-aware

features.description: Validate inputs before scheduling and derive page, observation, table, file, origin, and manifest access keys.
Overlap only calls with no write/read or write/write conflict and run undeclared tools serially.
Buffer model-visible results and derived state, then commit in original call order while serializing manifest writes.
Retain bounded concurrency and existing per-turn, whole-run, per-result, and combined-result caps.

completionCriteria: Same-page and same-table calls serialize while independent resources overlap.
Invalid input causes zero side effects and out-of-order completion remains deterministic.
Missing access declarations fail safely to serial execution.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/loop/scheduler.test.ts src/loop/agentLoop.test.ts src/tools/pipeline.test.ts src/tools/registry.test.ts src/tools/index.test.ts

tasks.title: Add bounded research jobs

features.description: Run bounded entity jobs in isolated public headless sessions with linked cancellation and individual transcripts.
Reuse one stable worker prefix and restrict child tools and shared-state access.
Return typed rows, evidence, limitations, and usage rather than child conversations.
Merge in deterministic order, namespace row IDs, validate evidence, and surface conflicts without last-writer wins.
Limit public concurrency to two or three and keep headed/authenticated work serial under the coordinator.

completionCriteria: Independent fixture jobs overlap without sharing browser or output-table state.
Failed children do not discard successful results and conflicts are explicit.
All child usage counts against parent budgets and metrics.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/research/researchJob.test.ts src/research/researchRegistry.test.ts src/research/mergeResearchResults.test.ts src/tools/runResearchJobs/runResearchJobs.test.ts src/run/runBudget.test.ts src/model/callModel.test.ts

tasks.title: Add cache-safe compact memory

features.description: Derive AgentContext from contract, output summaries, browser pages, recent events, and repeated failures.
Keep the cached prefix stable and append state snapshots only when their source hash changes.
Compact only at explicit cache boundaries without removing current contract, output, evidence, or unresolved failure state.
Freeze tool-result inline/offload decisions and preview bytes across history replay.
Measure pass rate, cache use, cost, latency, context peak, and repeated-action rate against non-compact mode.

completionCriteria: Unchanged state produces byte-identical history and cache markers.
Old repeated failures remain visible after raw history compaction.
Compact memory graduates only if pass rate holds and wall time or cost improves.
tasks.focusedTestCommand: npx vitest run src/loop/agentContext.test.ts src/loop/contextView.test.ts src/loop/workerSession.test.ts src/model/callModel.test.ts

tasks.title: Cut over to V2 and retire superseded paths

features.description: Freeze one deterministic V2 production tool order and static prompt snapshot.
Remove browser_batch, raw requested-output CSV, prose contract, and implicit completion paths only after their parity gates pass.
Propagate truthful RunOutcome through CLI, TUI, eval output, and reports while retaining legacy run readability.
Prepare the four-way contract-author/verifier comparison and run it only with user approval.
Update summaries, handoff state, demos, and production defaults after the measured decision.

completionCriteria: Production has one driver, contract, verifier protocol, completion path, and frozen registry.
No false-success control path remains and old run directories are still readable.
Typecheck and full hermetic tests pass; live evaluation requires explicit user direction.
